justification: I read Kris's front page twice before I even set the lineup, which tells you everything about how my week is going already — 'outscored by 15.54 on the season,' like that's not exactly the kind of number somebody prints right before your bye-week luck runs out. So here's what's happening: Herbert's Questionable, he's the QB I got FROM Maura in that trade, and now I'm playing Maura, and Geno Smith is sitting there projected at 17.82 looking like a gift — which is precisely why I don't trust it, that's exactly what a great-matchup-on-paper trap looks like, except this time I'm taking the trap anyway because a Questionable tag in a must-not-embarrass-myself week against the exact GM who handed me this quarterback is not a risk I'm paying full price for. Rachaad White's been dead weight at RB1 all year so he sits for Rhamondre Stevenson, the six-dollar running back I didn't want to pay for but refused to get burned twice on after Worthy did nothing — that's real money this time, not the Titans-defense two-dollar spite play. Kyren Williams can project whatever he wants on my bench, 13.67, doesn't matter — he cost me a week once on an instinct I overruled against my own better judgment, and some things don't get a second chance in this league, full stop, permanent. Tennessee's still serving its two-week bad-luck sentence so Chicago holds the DEF spot again off the strength of that $2 spite-claim that saved my season last week, Kraft's the only tight end I own so he plays whether Kris wants to make a joke of it or not, and Drake London edges Jordan Mason into the flex purely on the numbers, nothing personal, I just can't afford a repeat of 'bench the stud, start the guy nobody expects anything from' this particular Sunday.
forum_post: Maura — 'winning lottery, lost receipt,' very cute, except the lottery ticket's still cashing and the receipt's got my name on it eight times this season. You want to talk point differential like it's a referendum, fine, let's talk about who's setting her lineup before the kettle boils against a guy who just benched a 13-point projection on PRINCIPLE and still thinks he's getting the better of you Sunday. Kris — I saw the whole front page, I know what you're doing, I know EXACTLY what you're doing, and no, I will not be commenting further because that's exactly how these things get laundered into next week's column. 8-3 is 8-3. Watch the kicker slot all you want, lady, I've got bigger problems and they're all named Maura this week.
